    StartersViktor's Ukrainian derunyPotato pancakes with sour cream and dill, the way Ivan and Viktor train in UkraineHow to make it800g floury potatoes, peeled1 onion1 egg3 tbsp plain flour4 tbsp vegetable oil200g sour cream2 tbsp dill, choppedsalt and pepper, to tasteGrate the potatoes and onion on the coarse side of a grater.Tip into a clean tea towel and squeeze out as much liquid as you can.Mix with the egg, flour and plenty of salt and pepper.Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry heaped spoonfuls, flattened, for 3 to 4 minutes a side, in batches, until deep golden and crisp. Drain.Stir half the dill through the sour cream and serve with the hot deruny and the rest of the dill on top.Proposal night tuna tostadasTuna tostadas for the night Adonis proposes and Bianca says yesHow to make it8 small corn tortillas1 tbsp vegetable oil300g sashimi-grade tuna2 limes1 tbsp soy sauce1 tsp sesame oil2 spring onions, thinly sliced3 tbsp mayonnaise1 tsp chipotle chillies in adobo, chopped1 avocado2 tbsp fried shallotssalt, to tasteHeat the oven to 200°C. Brush the tortillas with the oil and bake on a tray until crisp, turning once.Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle.Mash the avocado with the juice of half a lime and salt.Dice the tuna and toss with the juice of 1 lime, the soy sauce, sesame oil and spring onions.Spread the tostadas with avocado, top with the tuna, a little chipotle mayonnaise and the fried shallots. Serve with the last lime half in wedges.Blue PlatesThe desert camp chilliBeef chilli for the desert camp where Rocky and Little Duke rebuild him, with rice, sour cream and cheddarHow to make it800g beef chuck, diced2 tbsp vegetable oil1 onion, diced3 garlic cloves, crushed2 tsp ground cumin2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp dried oregano2 tbsp chipotle chillies in adobo, chopped400g tinned chopped tomatoes500ml beef stock400g tinned kidney beans, drained20g dark chocolate300g long-grain rice150g sour cream80g cheddar, grated2 spring onions, slicedsalt, to tasteSeason the beef with salt and brown well in the oil in batches in a heavy pot. Lift out.Soften the onion and garlic in the same pot.Stir in the cumin, paprika, oregano and chipotle for 1 minute, then return the beef with the tomatoes and stock. Simmer, covered, on low until the beef is very tender.Stir in the beans and chocolate and simmer, uncovered, until thick. Meanwhile cook the rice.Season and serve over the rice with sour cream, cheddar and spring onion.Adrian's chicken cacciatore with soft polentaThighs braised with tomato, capsicum, olives and rosemary over soft parmesan cornmealHow to make it1kg chicken thighs, bone in1 onion, sliced2 red capsicums, sliced3 garlic cloves, sliced800g tinned chopped tomatoes80g black olives2 sprigs of rosemary200g instant polenta1 L chicken stock50g parmesan, grated2 tbsp olive oilBrown the chicken in the oil, then lift out.Soften the onion, capsicum and garlic in the pan.Add the tomatoes, olives and rosemary, put the chicken back and simmer covered until tender.Bring the stock to the boil, whisk in the polenta and stir until thick, then beat in the parmesan. Serve with the chicken.Pie and SweetsMoscow fight night honey cakeThin honey sponge layers stacked with whipped sour cream, left overnight to go soft, finished with honey crumbsHow to make it100g honey100g caster sugar80g butter2 eggs1 tsp bicarbonate of soda350g plain flour300ml thickened cream500g sour cream100g icing sugarMelt the honey, caster sugar and butter in a bowl over simmering water.Whisk in the eggs, then the bicarb, until it foams and turns golden. Off the heat, work in the flour to a soft dough.Cover and rest until cool enough to handle. Heat the oven to 180°C.Divide into 6, roll each thinly on baking paper, cut to a 20cm round using a plate and bake each for about 6 minutes until golden. Keep the offcuts and bake them too.Blitz the offcuts to fine crumbs.Whip the cream to soft peaks, then whisk in the sour cream and icing sugar.Stack the layers with the cream between each, cover the top and sides and press on the crumbs.Chill overnight.Coffee and PopDesert camp watermelon agua frescaFresh watermelon blended with lime and a little sugar, strained over ice with mintHow to make it1.2kg seedless watermelon flesh, chopped2 limes, juiced2 tbsp caster sugar250ml cold water2 cups ice4 sprigs of mintBlend the watermelon, lime juice, sugar and water until smooth.Strain through a sieve into a jug.Chill until very cold.Pour over ice in 4 glasses and add a mint sprig.
